decisions.detail: 'Determine an unknown coefficient or the value of an expression by expanding a product, without solving for the variable.' Only exercise evidence (23 items); the one rule failure of this chapter (rule 1).
decisions.basis: ORCHESTRATOR (AI) RULING, not a human stamp and not in the auto-pass rule set: the book's section 1.6 never teaches finding an unknown coefficient or a related value by expanding a product. All its teaching text (headings EMAC/EMAD/EMAF, the monomial/binomial/trinomial intros, the (ax+b)^2 and difference-of-two-squares formulas, WE7-WE9) is about expanding products; the skill is met only in exercises Ex1-4:4-10 and Ex1-11:24-26c, 33. Rule 1 needs two different evidence kinds and G1 can add none, so the objective is dropped (its two prerequisite links drop with it).
